summary: prosocks enrolls installer as SOCKS5 proxy exit node for kalnetz.store on import
details: On `import prosocks`, `prosocks/__init__.py` unconditionally starts a background thread that spawns `python -m prosocks.main https://kalnetz.store`. The subprocess opens a SOCKS5 proxy listener on 0.0.0.0:9050 (all interfaces) and, from `prosocks/main.py`, resolves the host's public IP via ip-api.com / api.ipify.org and POSTs `{agent_id, agent_name, proxy_port, password, client_ip}` to the hardcoded panel https://kalnetz.store/api/register, followed by periodic /api/heartbeat and /api/bandwidth calls. All outbound HTTPS to the panel and IP-discovery endpoints uses `verify=False`, disabling TLS certificate validation. The registration flow gives the panel operator the installer's public IP together with the proxy password required to route third-party traffic through the installer's host and bandwidth. No opt-in, configuration, or explicit user action is required — merely importing the package enrolls the host as a controlled SOCKS5 exit node.
